cards.title: Check in with Corpus Departure
cards.leadIn: At 500 ft MSL, when directed by Tower:

exchange.speaker: Pilot
exchange.text: Corpus Departure, <callsign>, 500 feet off Navy Corpus, KINGS 4.

exchange.speaker: Departure
exchange.text: <callsign>, Corpus Departure, radar contact <distance and direction> of Navy Corpus. Proceed course rules KINGS 4.
